Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 64
Nepal
Federal
Parliament
Notice - 2
(Brief Minutes of the Meeting Proceedings)
Tuesday, October 13, 2083
The first meeting of the House of Representatives today commenced at 10:10 AM under the chairmanship of the Right Honourable Speaker Dol Prasad Aryal.
At the beginning of the meeting, Honourable Dhuraj Rai took an impromptu time and stated that the Right Honourable Prime Minister should be present in the parliament to answer the Honourable members' questions and that the government should take the matter seriously, drawing attention to the fact that the question-and-answer program with the Prime Minister, scheduled for August 10, has not yet taken place.
Thereafter, in the Zero Hour that commenced, the following Honourable members expressed their views on contemporary issues:-

Subsequently, Honourable Chairperson of the Education, Health, and Information Technology Committee, Ojaswi Sherchan, presented the "Report of the Committee on the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2083" which originated in the National Assembly.
After that, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister and Minister of Defence, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam proposed a motion seeking permission to present the "National Defence University Bill, 2083".
Thereafter, as no notice of objection was received from any Honourable member in accordance with Rule 105 of the House of Representatives Rules, 2083, on the motion seeking permission to present the said bill, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister and Minister of Defence, presented the "National Defence University Bill, 2083".
Subsequently, Honourable Minister of Physical Infrastructure and Transport Sunil Lamsal proposed a motion seeking permission to present the "Diploma in Engineering Council Bill, 2083".
After that, as no notice of objection was received from any Honourable member in accordance with Rule 104 of the House of Representatives Rules, 2083, on the motion seeking permission to present the said bill, Honourable Minister of Physical Infrastructure and Transport Sunil Lamsal presented the "Diploma in Engineering Council Bill, 2083".
Thereafter, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam presented the motion "Consideration of the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws, 2083".
Subsequently, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister, responded to the questions raised by the following Honourable members during the discussion on the said bill:-

Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker presented the motion "Consideration of the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws, 2083" for decision, and it was unanimously approved.
Subsequently, the Right Honourable Speaker informed that Honourable members wishing to give notice of amendment to the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws, 2083" in accordance with Rule 112 of the House of Representatives Rules, 2083, can submit their notice to the Bill Section (House of Representatives), Federal Parliament Secretariat, Singh Durbar.
Thereafter, Honourable Minister of Health and Population Nisha Mehta presented the motion "Consideration of the Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Sciences Institute Bill, 2083".
Subsequently, Honourable Minister of Health and Population Nisha Mehta responded to the questions raised by the following Honourable members during the discussion on the said bill:-

Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker presented the motion "Consideration of the Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Sciences Institute Bill, 2083" for decision, and it was unanimously approved.
Subsequently, the Right Honourable Speaker informed that Honourable members wishing to give notice of amendment to the "Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Sciences Institute Bill, 2083" in accordance with Rule 112 of the House of Representatives Rules, 2083, can submit their notice to the Bill Section (House of Representatives), Federal Parliament Secretariat, Singh Durbar.
Thereafter, the next meeting of the House of Representatives was adjourned until 12:45 PM today, to be held 15 minutes later.

At the beginning of the meeting, Honourable Minister of Law, Justice, and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam, on behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister and Minister of Defence, presented the motion "Consideration of the National Defence University Bill, 2083".

Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker informed that the item numbered 2 on today's agenda has been removed from the list of business.
Thereafter, the next meeting of the House of Representatives was adjourned until 1:00 PM on Wednesday, October 14, 2083, at 3:14 PM today.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The House received a report on the National Forensic Science Laboratory Bill. It then proceeded to present and discuss the National Defence University Bill, the Diploma in Engineering Council Bill, the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws, and the Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Sciences Institute Bill. Ministers responded to questions on the latter two bills.
